title: Lesson 0.0: Mastery Starter

scenes.vo: Lesson zero point zero. Mastery Starter.

scenes.sub: Crypto is money recorded on a public ledger that nobody can quietly edit. You'll open an exchange account, buy a little crypto, move it into a wallet only you control, and make your first practice DeFi transaction, all with a small amount and a checklist.

scenes.title: Words you'll need
scenes.vo: Blockchain, a shared ledger kept by thousands of computers. Wallet, an app or device holding the keys that control your crypto. Seed phrase, 12–24 words that are your wallet. Never share. Exchange, a company that swaps your money for crypto. Gas, the network fee for a transaction.
